title: Tell him silly Milly sends my best respects. I must now close with fondest love
html_source: Even initial readers will know ‘Tell him silly Milly’ refers to Boylan and the informality of the phrase is surprising. Through several explicit references to Boylan, conversational implicature and Bloom’s dark thoughts the reader becomes more aware that Boylan is a person of interest in the Bloom household.
